Container.Name: forma
Container.Overview: Forma: a personal, image-first STL catalog. /data holds your catalog and uploads; /library is your existing model share mounted read-only.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: SQLite database, uploaded models and images

Config.Name: Existing models
Config.Description: Change this to your model share. Existing files are never modified.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Required. Seeds the owner password on first start. Use HTTPS when accessing remotely.
